codebase-memory._description: Codebase Memory — converts your codebase into a persistent knowledge graph stored in SQLite. Enables cross-session memory of file relationships, symbols, and architectural patterns.
_usage: 2. Index codebase: the server indexes on first connection
3. Query: ask Copilot about codebase structure and it will use the graph
4. The graph persists across Copilot CLI sessions
